title: Personal Services Plan Billing Terms — Hours Drawn, Surcharges and A La Carte Charges
content:
These are the billing terms for services delivered under the Personal Services Plan.

## Clause 1 — Two kinds of service

Services the tier lists as hourly services are delivered against personal service hours, and services the tier lists as a la carte services are priced separately.

## Clause 2 — Measuring delivered time

Delivered time of an hourly service is rounded up to the next billing increment of the tier and never counted below the tier's minimum hours per visit, or below the companion visit minimum for a companion visit. Unit-priced hourly services — laundry loads and linen changes — convert to hours by their hours-per-unit equivalent.

*Hypothetical illustrations, taking a 15-minute increment and a 0.5-hour minimum:* 50 delivered minutes count as 60 minutes, or 1.00 hour; 20 delivered minutes round up to 30 minutes, which equals the 0.5-hour minimum; a companion visit of 40 minutes counts as 1.0 hour, the companion visit minimum.

## Clause 3 — Weekend and holiday surcharges

Hours delivered on a Saturday or Sunday are increased by the tier's weekend surcharge percentage, and hours delivered on a date in the Larkspur holiday calendar are increased by the tier's holiday surcharge percentage instead. The holiday surcharge takes precedence and the two never add together.

| Delivery date | Increase applied to the hours |
|---|---|
| A Larkspur holiday, including one that falls on a Saturday or Sunday | Holiday surcharge percentage only |
| A Saturday or Sunday that is not a Larkspur holiday | Weekend surcharge percentage |
| Any other date | None |

## Clause 4 — Drawing hours and charging the remainder

The resulting hours are drawn from the hours available on the plan. Where fewer hours remain than are needed, the remaining hours are drawn and the rest are charged at the tier's hourly rate beyond the allotment as one hourly charge on the same order, each amount rounded to the cent half up.

The hours available on the plan are the hours granted, rolled over and restored, less the hours drawn and the hours expired, as booked up to the moment of the draw.

*Hypothetical illustration:* a visit counted at 1.75 hours on a plan with 0.25 hour available draws the 0.25 hour and charges the other 1.5 hours as one hourly charge on the same order; at a hypothetical hourly rate of 50.00 USD that charge is 75.00 USD.

## Clause 5 — A la carte services

A la carte services are never drawn from hours:

- private transportation at the tier's rate per mile, with the tier's minimum charge per trip;
- handyman work at the tier's handyman hourly rate, with the tier's handyman minimum hours;
- an overnight companion at the tier's flat rate per night;
- a grocery delivery at the tier's delivery fee, except that the first deliveries in a calendar month up to the tier's number of free deliveries are posted at 0.00. The deliveries of a month are counted including the free deliveries posted at 0.00.

The tier's member discount percentage is deducted from each a la carte charge, rounded to the cent half up.

*Hypothetical illustration:* on a tier with 2 free grocery deliveries a month, the first and second deliveries of the month are posted at 0.00 and the third at the delivery fee less the member discount. With a hypothetical delivery fee of 10.00 USD and a hypothetical member discount of 5%, the third delivery is 10.00 less 0.50, posted as 9.50 USD.

## Clause 6 — Which orders are drawn and charged

Hours are drawn and charged only for an order that was booked and then delivered, cancelled late or missed, and each order is drawn at most once and charged at most once for each reason it is drawn (delivered, late cancellation, no-show).

## Note on hourly charge amounts

An hourly charge is the hours charged multiplied by the tier's hourly rate beyond the allotment, rounded to the cent half up. *Hypothetical:* 1.25 hours at 46.50 USD per hour is 58.125, charged as 58.13 USD.
